ASUS TUF Gaming F16 FX607VJB Core 5-210H RTX 3050 Gaming Laptop


Dominate the battlefield and accelerate your productivity with the ASUS TUF Gaming F16. Powered by the efficient Intel Core 5-210H processor and 8GB of high-speed RAM, this laptop is built to deliver smooth gaming performance, seamless multitasking, and reliable daily computing. Paired with the NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 (6GB VRAM), you can enjoy modern gaming titles with crisp graphics and take advantage of AI-accelerated workflows and smooth video editing.


Equipped with a fast 512GB NVMe SSD, the system ensures rapid boot times and quick game loading. The immersive 16-inch Full HD+ display features an ultra-smooth 144Hz refresh rate and IPS technology, eliminating motion blur to give you a competitive edge in fast-paced action. Wrapped in a signature military-grade durable TUF chassis and pre-installed with Windows 11, this heavy-duty machine is ready for peak gaming and serious work right out of the box.
